data.name: Solspire
data.detailed_description:
DEMO PLAYABLE NOW — LINK ON THE RIGHT

Travel the long and arduous journey to reach the Solspire, alone or with friends.

Solspire is an open-world sandbox RPG using old-school D&D-inspired gameplay mechanics and true player freedom. Choose your race and class, roll your attributes, and set off on your adventure.

Travel through sun and snow, explore dangerous dungeons, slay goblins, ogres, dragons, and other deadly creatures, collect powerful loot, and sell your spoils in distant towns. Slowly make your way toward the Solspire—but be warned: it is a long, long journey.

Solspire has full Steam multiplayer support, and servers can comfortably handle more than 32 players.

Features


  • Races: Human, Dwarf, Elf, Half-Elf, Halfling, Gnome, and Half-Orc
  • Classes: Fighter, Paladin, Rogue, Cleric, Ranger, Druid, Wizard, and Sorcerer
  • Open-world exploration across forests, mountains, snowfields, towns, and forgotten ruins
  • Dangerous dungeons filled with monsters, treasure, and secrets
  • Old-school attributes, character creation, equipment, magic, and progression
  • Solo play, adventures with friends, and large multiplayer servers
  • A vast journey toward the distant Solspire

Solspire is still heavily under development. Try the demo and please give us your feedback.
